text_block_list.text:
I suppose you could say that. I made a
bit of a
mistake...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I went to wash Tamtam's tracksuit, you
see, but I
accidentally poured bleach in.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I never make mistakes like that.
Honestly, I can't
believe myself.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Tamtam brushed it off in her usual way
with a
smile and a joke...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: But I'm still trying to figure out how I could even mess up like that. Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
